gripOrHq.title: Rent-to-Own Contract
gripOrHq.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put on that ice a number of Term counters equal to its rez cost. At the start of each of your turns, if you have at least [2], lose [2] and remove one of these Term counters; otherwise, put a Term counter on that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Credit Consolidation
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [15].

gripOrHq.title: Homing Missile
gripOrHq.rulesText: *Trace x-If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot make another run until Runner takes an action to pay [2]. Pay X, above the rez cost, when you rez Homing Missile. X is Homing Missile 's strength and trace limit, and X cannot be greater than 8.

gripOrHq.title: Digiconda
gripOrHq.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage. *End the run. Pay [X], above the rez cost, when you rez Digiconda. X is Digiconda 's strength, and X cannot be greater than 6.

gripOrHq.title: Gatekeeper
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gatekeeper has one "*End the run" subroutine for every [2] you pay, above the rez cost, when you rez it.

rig.title: “Green Knight” Surge Buffers
rig.rulesText: Prevents up to 1 Net damage each turn.

gripOrHq.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

gripOrHq.title: Project Venice
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

gripOrHq.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.
